content.bridge_context: Discovering how water changes its form (Solid, Liquid, Gas) and the journey it takes in nature.

units.title: Three States of Water
units.explanation: Water can be ice (solid), water (liquid), or steam/vapor (gas).
units.dual_language_instruction: Look at an ice cube. What happens when it melts? / बर्फ के टुकड़े को देखें। पिघलने पर क्या होता है?

units.title: Evaporation and Condensation
units.explanation: Water turns to vapor when heated (evaporation) and vapor turns to water when cooled (condensation).
units.dual_language_instruction: Notice the droplets on a cold water bottle. Where did they come from? / ठंडे पानी की बोतल पर बूंदों को देखें। वे कहाँ से आईं?
